newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks end volatile day slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks end volatile day slightly firmer.

text.p: South African shares ended the day on a firmer footing as institutions seeking bargains entered the market in late trade. Golds ended a touch stronger after hovering in negative territory for most of the day.
Trading was choppy throughout the day, with stocks tossed back and forth by the rand which slid to fresh lows against the U.S. dollar and British pound.
The market initially bounced at the open, only to fall back when the rand pierced the 4.70 level against the dollar.
It was seen looking to Wall Street and the rand for direction on Thursday.
The overall index ended up 23.8 points 6,891.8 points, the industrial index gained 10.3 points to 8,124.7 points and the gold index added 2.1 points to 1,708.1 points.
